import_archive.name: Import inverter archive
import_archive.description: Manually import completed archive days into Recorder statistics. Existing hourly timestamps are replaced and are not duplicated.

days.name: Completed days
days.description: Number of completed days before today.

config_entry_id.name: Config entry ID
config_entry_id.description: Optional when only one plant is configured.

get_archive.name: Get official five-minute archive
get_archive.description: Return every original SMA archive point without interpolation or padding; all inverters in an entry must return the same timestamp series.

config_entry_id.name: Config entry ID
config_entry_id.description: Optional when only one plant is configured.

user.title: Connect an SMA-Net2 Bluetooth plant
user.description: Nearby SMA devices are detected through the local BlueZ adapter. Select exactly the inverter you want to test. NetID 1 is configured directly; NetID 2-F can expose the complete network. Nearby devices are never assumed to share a network.

confirm.title: Confirm detected SMA topology
confirm.description: Detected **NetID {net_id}**. Configured mode: **{configured_mode}**; effective mode: **{effective_mode}**. Inverter serials: **{serials}**. Current root: **{root}**. Submit to create this entry.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure an SMA-Net2 entry
reconfigure.description: Select one physical inverter and the intended operating mode. Leave the password empty to retain the current password. The detected NetID and serials are shown before anything changes.

reconfigure_confirm.title: Confirm changed SMA topology
reconfigure_confirm.description: Detected **NetID {net_id}**. Configured mode: **{configured_mode}**; effective mode: **{effective_mode}**. Inverter serials: **{serials}**. Current root: **{root}**. Submit to update and reload this entry without changing serial-based entity identities.

error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to the plant or log in
error.invalid_auth: The SMA user password is invalid
error.discovery_failed: Automatic Bluetooth Classic discovery failed; enter the address manually
error.invalid_address: Enter a valid Bluetooth MAC address
error.nighttime: SMA connection tests are paused until sunrise
error.network_requires_netid_2_f: Full network mode requires NetID 2-F; this device reports NetID 1
error.serial_overlap: At least one detected inverter serial is still claimed by another SMA entry. Resolve or remove that entry first.

abort.already_configured: This SMA-Net2 Bluetooth plant is already configured
abort.cannot_connect: The detected SMA session is no longer available; start the flow again

serial_overlap.title: SMA inverter {serial} belongs to multiple entries

init.title: Resolve duplicate SMA ownership
init.description: Serial **{serial}** is claimed by: {entries}. Remove or reconfigure the unwanted entry, then submit this repair again. Entity IDs and Recorder history are transferred only after exactly one entry claims the serial.

error.still_present: The serial is still claimed by multiple entries

network_to_single.title: SMA network changed from NetID {old_net_id} to {new_net_id}

init.title: Split the SMA network entry safely
init.description: Reconfigure **{entry}** to `single` or `auto` with one inverter address. Afterwards add each remaining inverter as its own entry. Existing serial-based entity IDs remain registered and move when the new owner is configured. Submit again after the entry has been reconfigured.

error.still_present: The entry has not yet been reconfigured for the detected NetID

init.title: Consolidate SMA entries safely
init.description: First remove the other single-inverter entry for this plant. Then reconfigure **{entry}** to `network` or `auto`. The removal hook transfers serial registries to the remaining matching entry before Home Assistant cleanup. Submit again after both actions.

error.still_present: The entries have not yet been consolidated for the detected NetID

init.title: Confirm the changed SMA NetID
init.description: Reconfigure **{entry}** and confirm NetID **{new_net_id}**, mode, and detected serials. Submit again after reconfiguration.

error.still_present: The changed NetID has not yet been confirmed

bluetooth_recovery_failed.title: SMA Bluetooth recovery failed
bluetooth_recovery_failed.description: SMA communication through **{address}** remained unavailable after the integration power-cycled the local Bluetooth adapter. Check the adapter and inverter power, then reload the SMA integration. The integration will keep retrying automatically.
